reason: No fixed version exists: the advisory covers picomatch <= 4.0.7, which is the latest, and the latest Vite depends on it. The denial of service needs an attacker to supply the glob pattern. DesignBench and Vite compile patterns only from project source and configuration, which SECURITY.md already treats as trusted. picomatch is not bundled, so installs resolve it themselves and get the fix as soon as one is published.
